_meta.use: Deep links and the screen each must open (QA-05, REL checks). Test cold start, warm start and signed-out states. Domain trybonded.com (D30, MOB-02): release builds set EXPO_PUBLIC_INVITE_DOMAIN=trybonded.com and share https://trybonded.com/j/... links; a build with it empty (local and QA simulator builds) shares bonded://j/BND<code>?t=<token> instead (lead-accepted fallback), so test the https rows on a build with the domain and the bonded:// rows on any build.

links.signed_in_unpaired: J3 with code filled (no token, so no J2)
links.signed_in_paired: J3 with code filled; sending it shows the ALREADY_PAIRED error
links.signed_out: J3 with code filled (no token, so no J2)

links.installed: J2 then J3 with code filled
links.not_installed: web fallback page, then the store; after install J3 manual code (P0) or prefilled (P1 deferred link)

links.installed: J2 Personal welcome (MOB-40, cold and warm), then J4 sign-in (signed out) or J5 (signed in); accept succeeds even after 5 failed attempts in 15 min (D02 token skips the limit)
links.not_installed: web fallback page, then the store; token kept for the P1 deferred link
